Common questions

How quickly can you reach me?

Our target is one hour to any address inside the Leeds ring road, and ninety minutes to the outer postcodes. Overnight calls are answered by the same engineers who work days.

Do you charge a call-out fee?

There is no separate call-out fee. You are quoted a single price on the phone before an engineer is dispatched, and that price does not change when we arrive.

Can you open a lock without damaging the door?

In most cases yes. Non-destructive entry works on the majority of domestic cylinders, and we only drill a lock when the mechanism has already failed internally.

Which payment methods do you accept?

Card payment is taken on site by the engineer, and we can invoice landlords and letting agents on account after the first job.
